'''D''' is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that first appears in [[Dreaming Deep]]. She is the master of the Somnoire's Cinema Layer, Deep Water Zone.<!-- and to be an offshoot of an ancient Threnodian that once invaded the Somnoire "DAN: This is a theory from a video, not confirmed officially."--> At the end of ''The Cinema House Murders'', D challenges Rover to a detective game to uncover some kind of mystery within the Somnoire that has yet to be revealed.

Due to the writing style, interest in films, and also being located in the Somnoire, some speculate she is also known as '''Aurelia''', the author of a review of ''[["The Tale of Two Love Birds" Review II|The Tale of Two Love Birds]]''. As she calls Rover "Great Detective," she is also likely hiding under the guise of "[[Dorothy]]" in [[Depths of Illusive Realm/2026-05-21|Depths of Illusive Realm: Chromatic Fantasy]].
